definition.legacy_windows_path_order_sha256: SHA-256 over relpath UTF-8 + NUL + file SHA-256 hex + LF, iterating Python sorted(Path objects) on the Windows host; retained for Pass 346 evaluator compatibility.
definition.canonical_posix_relpath_order_sha256: Same row framing, but rows sorted by exact POSIX-style relative-path strings; platform-independent ordering referent.
definition.canonical_manifest_json_sha256: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON mapping relative path -> {bytes,sha256}, with JSON keys sorted; strongest portable manifest identity in this convergence seal.
